component.name: Ember
component.summary: Comic-style system monitor and control center for COSMIC

description.p: Ember shows what your machine is doing as hand-drawn comic panels with live charts, and lets you control it: processes, services, power profiles, graphics mode, CPU scaling and every installed app from APT, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, cargo, npm and bun.
It also ships panel applets for the COSMIC desktop (clock, sound, Bluetooth, network, power, tiling, session, media, keep awake, live readings) and a desktop widget.
